items.title: Route `/apps` renders Apps
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /apps
THEN the apps screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Route `/apps/create` renders CreateToolkit (application mode)
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /apps/create
THEN the create toolkit screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Route `/apps/create/:appType` renders CreateToolkit (application mode)
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /apps/create/:appType
THEN the create toolkit screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Route `/apps/:tab` renders Apps
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /apps/:tab
THEN the apps screen is displayed at that URL
AND covers /apps/applications and /apps/catalog

items.title: Route `/apps/:tab/:appId` renders AppDetail
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /apps/:tab/:appId
THEN the app detail screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Query param `view` on /apps/:tab
acceptance: GIVEN the application is at /apps/:tab
WHEN the URL contains the view query parameter with a valid value
THEN the corresponding panel or view state is applied on cold load, without a full page reload
AND the same state change performed by interaction updates the URL parameter accordingly
AND a malformed value is rejected without crashing the screen

items.title: Query param `view` on /apps/:tab/:appId
acceptance: GIVEN the application is at /apps/:tab/:appId
WHEN the URL contains the view query parameter with a valid value
THEN the corresponding panel or view state is applied on cold load, without a full page reload
AND the same state change performed by interaction updates the URL parameter accordingly
AND a malformed value is rejected without crashing the screen

items.title: Copy: apps/Apps.jsx (2 strings)
acceptance: GIVEN the apps screen renders with the default brand in both colour schemes
WHEN its user-visible texts are compared with the baseline application
THEN all 2 strings from this component (for example "Applications") appear verbatim
AND no string is dropped, truncated or reworded
